ruleset.name: no-internal-server-error
ruleset.description: Backend modules, production AND test code: a 500 means an unforeseen bug in this service, so code must never produce one on purpose and tests must never expect one. Outages are 503 (dependency or database unreachable / timed out) and bad upstream answers 502 - see common Downstream and ApiErrorHandler. Test harness/ packages are exempt: a WireMock stub may simulate a DEPENDENCY answering 500 (that is the scenario, and this service must answer 502).

rule.name: NoInternalServerError
rule.message: Never produce or expect HTTP 500: outages are 503, bad upstream answers 502 (common Downstream / ApiErrorHandler)
